title: Meridian flip failure lost when it interrupts an endless capture
summary: The imager reports an aborted endless batch (capture_batch(-1, ...)) with AGENT_START_PROCESS Ok, so the capture step paused by a failed flip succeeded and the failure policy was not applied. Next: keep the flip failure until the step ends and fail the step then.

resolution.evidence: Test 'meridian flip failure during endless capture recovers' passes and fails when the deferred check in execute_next is removed; verification.md, mutation-checks.txt.
